name: progress
title: Draft learner progress report
for_each: select id,name from enrolments order by name

sections.title: Enrolment
sections.sql: select b.learner,b.course,b.status,b.start_on,b.end_on from enrolment_board b where b.id=$1
sections.note: Staff review required. This is not an issued qualification or statement of attainment.

sections.title: Results
sections.sql: select u.code,u.name,r.outcome,r.achieved_on,r.evidence_ref from results r join units u on u.id=r.unit_id where enrolment_id=$1
sections.note: Staff review required. This is not an issued qualification or statement of attainment.

sections.title: Attendance
sections.note: Staff review required. This is not an issued qualification or statement of attainment.

name: fee-statement
title: Draft learner fee statement
for_each: select id,name from enrolments order by name

sections.title: Learner
sections.sql: select learner,course from enrolment_board where id=$1
sections.note: Staff review required. This is not an issued qualification or statement of attainment.

sections.title: Invoices
sections.sql: select name,currency,amount_cents,paid_cents,amount_cents-paid_cents as balance_cents,due_on from invoices where enrolment_id=$1
sections.note: Staff review required. This is not an issued qualification or statement of attainment.

name: assessment-plan
title: Draft assessment follow-up plan
for_each: select id,name from enrolments order by name

sections.title: Learner and trainer
sections.sql: select learner,course,trainer from enrolment_board where id=$1
sections.note: Staff review required. This is not an issued qualification or statement of attainment.

sections.title: Assessments
sections.sql: select u.code,u.name,r.outcome,r.due_on,r.evidence_ref from results r join units u on u.id=r.unit_id where enrolment_id=$1
sections.note: Staff review required. This is not an issued qualification or statement of attainment.

name: record-of-results
title: Draft record of results
for_each: select id,name from enrolments order by name

sections.title: Learner
sections.sql: select learner,course,status,completed_on from enrolment_board where id=$1
sections.note: Staff review required. This is not an issued qualification or statement of attainment.

sections.title: Achieved results
sections.sql: select u.code,u.name,r.outcome,r.achieved_on from results r join units u on u.id=r.unit_id where enrolment_id=$1 and r.outcome in ('competent','credit-transfer','rpl')
sections.note: Staff review required. This is not an issued qualification or statement of attainment.

sections.title: Previously issued credential reference
sections.sql: select name,issued_on,document_ref,authorised_by from credentials where enrolment_id=$1
sections.note: Staff review required. This is not an issued qualification or statement of attainment.
